meta.units: All sizes are 4K pixels (3840x2160) at cluster scale 1.0 unless a key says otherwise. Multiply by the user cluster scale (0.70..1.40). Alpha values are 0..255 unless the key ends in Pct or Opacity (0..1).
meta.colourSpace: Hex values are sRGB. fh6-kit converts to linear premultiplied RGBA before blending (SKILLS.md law 1).
meta.designNote: The Penpot master file mirrors this file as token sets (docs/design/PENPOT.md). The Phase 3 HTML boards are described in docs/design/BOARDS.md.
meta.legacyKeys: typography.tiers, sharedSemantics and clusters.* are v1 values kept as reference; no code reads them since the v1 clusters were removed (Rust fix phase E, 2026-11-27). New work reads the v3 sections (colorRoles .. accessibility). Phase 7 replaces clusters.* per cluster.

typography.v1Note: tiers below are v1 point sizes; v3 type scale is in type.*

colorRoles.doc: Every cluster colours itself only through these roles. A palette (factory, custom or random) fills primary, secondary, accent and shift; the rest are fixed or derived.

primary.use: hero accents, tach fill, needle, ego car tint

secondary.use: trim, logo-zone ring, secondary arcs, sub-dial accents

accent.use: leading edges, meniscus orb core, focus, active segment

shift.use: rev-limiter strobe and the final shift-light stage

warning.use: redline sector, brake, alerts. Never replaced by a brand colour.

caution.use: caution stage, ABS/TCS active, slip warnings

rimSpecular.use: top of every 1 px specular rim

oledBlack.use: off pixels, VFD cavities, scrim core, singularities

derivedTextSafe.doc: Any role drawn as text or a thin line on black is lifted to stay readable.
derivedTextSafe.rule: convert to OKLCH; if L < minL raise L to minL keeping hue; clamp chroma to maxC

revStages.doc: Pods light on per-car, per-gear thresholds (car profile; fallback fractions below of shiftRpm), outside-in, 0 ms attack, landing on the centre pod above the gear. At shiftRpm the whole row takes the shift colour; at the limiter the row strobes (motion.limiterStrobe).

shift.note: violet lifted to OKLCH L 0.70 so the shift cue never drops in luminance below the red stage (>= 7:1 on black). Brands whose ShiftFlashHex is white strobe white; a palette validator keeps shift >= 60 deg of hue from primary.

thermal.doc: Discrete 4-step tyre / brake temperature (ACC convention). Steps crossfade over motion.durations.crossfade; never a continuous hue sweep.
thermal.unit: degC, per compound bands from the car profile when present

budget.doc: Colour is state, never decoration (RESEARCH principle 3). Checked per mockup with a lit-pixel histogram.

factory.doc: Brand palette from assets/car_brands/car_brands.json (BrandPalettes[brand]). Unknown brand uses BrandPalettes.DEFAULT, then the family default.

custom.doc: User sets primary, accent and shift in the OSD or configurator; secondary = primary rotated -30 deg hue at L-0.12 unless set.

random.doc: Re-roll generates a harmonious palette in OKLCH. A lock keeps it per cluster.

shift.rule: pick from [#FFFFFF, accent, #7C5CFF, #00E5FF] by highest contrast to stage3

random.forbidden: primary hue within 25 deg of the warning hue is rejected so red never means two things; shift must sit >= 60 deg of hue from primary

amgMbux.doc: The AMG MBUX dashes' own default palette (TJX, 2026-11-28: the Sporty dash is red like the real display, past the red budget). Used while the palette is factory or family; Custom and Random override it.

type.doc: Sizes are cap heights in 4K px at scale 1.0. Font size = capPx / capRatio of the active face, so user fonts keep the same optical size. Digits always use a fixed advance (tabular), whatever the face.

display.role: hero gear, speed, primary metrics (system default)

wide.role: wide wordmarks, custom name, sparse caps

aviation.role: HUD symbology numerics (designed for cockpit displays)

segment.role: VFD digits drawn as SDF segments by fh6-kit, not a font

race.role: Race Dash gear and values (bold condensed, white on black)

tabular.doc: Fixed digit cell = advanceEm x font size, digit centred in its cell. Speed is a fixed 3-cell field; unused leading cells draw the ghost glyph in inkGhost.

ghostByFamily.doc: ghost 8s belong to digital and VFD families; analog, glass and fluid faces suppress them

userFonts.doc: A user font replaces display (and optionally text). Layout keeps working because: sizes are cap-height based; digits use fixed cells; labels fit their box by shrinking to 85% then eliding; vertical centring uses cap height, not the em box.

type.rule: No text below type.scale.nano. Never more than 3 sizes in one cluster zone.

ratios.doc: Proportions from RESEARCH.md §9 (est., to verify on the C1).

type.tnumCheck: Phase 6 records per face whether tnum exists; fh6-kit forces fixed MSDF advances either way.

keyline.doc: hood view and any glyph over a bright scene: black ring around the strokes (MSDF outer distance), never a box

stroke.doc: Widths in 4K px. Specular rims are always exactly 1 px at any scale (snap to the pixel grid); other strokes scale.

glow.doc: Emissive levels for fh6-kit bloom. sigma in px at 4K. Two-lobe glows add a tight core and a wide halo. Bloom never exceeds 96 px radius (budget).
glow.rule: Only glance ranks 1–3 (shift lights, gear, speed, tach fill/needle) write to the emissive buffer that feeds bloom. Labels, bezels, tyres, G-ball and other rank 4–5 elements never glow.

glass.doc: Liquid Glass material for plates, pods and the OSD. Premium without background refraction; refraction is an optional layer when a captured game frame exists.

optics.doc: Physically based glass (fh6_kit::OpticalGlass); every equation is in docs/specs/optics.md. It replaces tintAlpha, rim, innerRim, crownSheen, fresnel, refraction, lensing and crescentAlpha below, which only the legacy slab material still reads.
optics.tintNote: Beer-Lambert: the colour that survives tintDepthPx of glass is clarity * (1 - tintAmount * (1 - primaryHue)); thicker glass is tinted more

keyLight.note: GGX lobe; direction from light.azimuthDeg and light.elevationDeg

environment.note: the studio map when a cluster ships one, else the kit's analytic studio; turns with the key light

rim.note: Vertical gradient along the outline; accent role may replace #38BDF8.

crownSheen.note: arched highlight under the top edge, offset by lateral G (motion.parallax)

caustic.procedural: two octaves of animated voronoi edges, 0.05 Hz drift
caustic.mask: edge band only: caustic *= 1 - smoothstep(48, 140, insetDistance); knocked out behind gear and speed; frozen at idle (phase from integrated speed, amplitude 0.3 + 0.7*clamp(|G|/1.2))

fresnel.note: legacy slab material only. 1.52 is a crown glass, not sapphire (1.768, R0 0.0770); see glass.optics

refraction.note: legacy slab material only: a fixed offset and split, not refraction. glass.optics bends by Snell's law with one index per channel

glass.contactShadow: none (OLED): separation comes from rims and inner glow, never from grey shadows

lensing.formula: uv += n * k * (1 - smoothstep(0, w, d))^2, k grows with element size

glass.arRimTintNote: the hue a quarter-wave MgF2 coat on sapphire reflects under white light (optics.md section 9): 0.4% red, 0.1% green, 1.2% blue. It was a guessed #7B6CFF. Liquid Glass is uncoated and does not use it

dimmingPad.doc: feathered black pad behind gear and speed; alpha = maxAlpha * (1 - scrimPct)

glass.dither: blue-noise tile on every low-alpha gradient (Phase 6 asset)

variants.rule: one variant per cluster, never mixed

materialize.doc: show ramps lensing and rim, not opacity; hide is 1 frame

materials.doc: Named looks with a texture (Phase 6) and a procedural fallback (fh6-kit). Phase 6 makes the textures.

guilloche.fallback: procedural line field in the dial shader

liquidMetal.note: environment banding + SDF smooth-union surface + spec highlight

motion.doc: Clusters animate from FrameInput dt. Springs are closed-form (period T in seconds, damping ratio zeta), exact at 60/120/144 Hz. Durations sit on the Material 3 50 ms scale.

needle.note: live needle; with velocity feed-forward the lag is <= 16.7 ms

parallax.note: hero 0, tach +/-2, bezel +/-4 px per g (lateral and longitudinal)

fluidSlosh.note: liquid surface tilt; deliberately under-damped, settles at zero input

shiftLights.note: same-frame on; short tail like an LED behind a lens

limiterStrobe.rule: Nothing taller than the strip flashes faster than 3 Hz; no large saturated-red area ever flashes (WCAG 2.3.1). Red washes are steady ramps, never strobes.

incoming.direction: up for upshift, down for downshift

upshiftGlow.doc: Liquid Glass: glow leaves the gear glyph and runs round the rims

gearChange.note: signature moment in every family; families add one flourish on top

ignitionSweep.trigger: first IsRaceOn 0->1 after launch only; never on unpause

speedDisplay.note: displayed integer changes only when |v - shown| >= 0.6 units, so the last digit never flickers

boot.doc: show slowly, hide instantly: gear and speed are live from frame 1; decorative layers materialize; sector boot for Sci-Fi

idle.rule: Idle is still: with constant telemetry nothing moves outside telemetry-bound regions. Fluid, particles and glitch are forced by telemetry or events and settle at zero input.

afterimage.doc: LFA-style: raw needle under 90 deg/s, up to 4 ghost needles above 180 deg/s

layout.doc: Local cluster coordinates are 4K px relative to the anchor at scale 1.0. Users move the anchor vertically and scale the envelope.

hudRaised.note: WindshieldHud: +240 px up the sightline from the cockpit anchor

zones.doc: Rank-ordered zones inside the cockpit envelope. Families move zones, but rank order and minimum sizes hold.

z2_speed.note: 460 px allows a tucked analog satellite (Classic) whose digits sit at its centre

logoZone.doc: Analog and some digital clusters reserve a logo zone. Phase 6 supplies a 4K logo (full, mono white, dial variant). If logo is off or missing, the custom name is set in type.fonts.wide.
logoZone.variant: dial (mono white at alpha 215 with a 1 px engraved shadow)

depthLayers.doc: hero, tach, bezel at parallax 0 / 2 / 4 px

densityTiers.doc: GT7 Race Info Only / Lucid Zen

defaultSweep.doc: symmetric linear face (0 at 7:30, max at 4:30)

trackMode.formula: angle = 270 + (rpm - shiftRpm) * 270 / maxRpm (screen degrees, 0 = 3 o'clock, clockwise)
trackMode.doc: Porsche-style per-car rotation so the needle stands vertical at the shift rpm; offered as a mode because a linear 270 deg face becomes lopsided when rotated

classicDial.operatingBand: peak-torque to peak-power rpm from the car profile, 9 px band on the chapter ring, lume green at 35%

states.doc: Reference telemetry for the 4 review states used by every mockup and golden render.

components.doc: Shared component anatomy. Full specs in docs/design/COMPONENTS.md; Phase 7 builds them once in crates/fh6-clusters/src/common/.

shiftLights.fill: outside-in by default; linear left-to-right allowed for linear16

pod.core: 2-stop radial, centre 40% toward white, edge full hue

adasRoad.note: Round-1 critique: the v1 eye (0, 1.85, -3.4) sits too low, so the ego roof covers the road ahead. Raised to a Tesla-style chase cam; ego in the bottom 40% of the scene band, lead car fully above the ego roof. AGENTS.md (Design Council 3D) still quotes the old eye and should be updated by the conductor.
adasRoad.groundFill: none: the road reads from edge lines, dashes and the carpet; an optional ground is a black dimming pad, never lit colour
adasRoad.trafficRules: traffic #8C929C at alpha 178, peak luminance <= 45% of the speed digits; no ambient car in an adjacent lane nearer than egoZ + 6 m; a blind-spot car shows only as the proximity arc plus a ghost body at alpha 0.30
adasRoad.egoHeading: path tangent + sign(kappa) * |slip|: the nose points into the bend in a drift (verify signs against tests/golden/packets before coding)

signedBar.doc: F1 MGU-K style signed bar above the gear: grows from centre, vanishes near zero

reducedFlash.effect: motion.limiterStrobe.reducedFlash replaces every strobe; nothing flashes above 3 Hz

accessibility.colourIndependence: every stage change is also a position or count change (more pods lit), never colour alone

blurGate.doc: CI gate on every mockup (RESEARCH principle 4)

accessibility.flashAudit: automated flash-area audit over preview-export frames (WCAG 2.3.1)
accessibility.glassTinted: OSD toggle raises glass to the tinted variant

light.doc: One virtual light per cluster drives every 1 px rim, facet and anisotropic finish (RESEARCH principle 5).
